cross_family_domains.type_token: quoted registered GimpToolOptions subclass GType name
cross_family_domains.default: tool-options NULL at construction; omitted tool-options makes loader reject corrupt preset. On native typed-object load, brush/dynamics/mybrush/painter-mybrush/pattern/gradient/palette/font initialize from current user context before supplied properties overlay. Remaining properties start at each exact class registration/default. Reader repairs tool/tool-info and preserves declared serialize_props.
cross_family_domains.type_rule: GimpTransformOptions is remapped to GimpTransformGridOptions in native reader. GimpPainterDeviceOptions is explicitly admitted. Other names must resolve and derive from GimpToolOptions.
cross_family_domains.member_rule: Declared fields are inherited according to exact saved GType, not every field on every subclass. MyPaint option members augment the config-family domain; device and MyPaint owners remain distinct.

limits: Finite schema members and parameterized/opaque schemas are separate contract records, not a count of runtime instances or873 independent fields.
